 Core Instrumentation
 Calorimetry
TA Discovery DSC 2500
Description
The DSC 2500 differential scanning calorimeter is a new instrument funded by the UW Student Technology Fee.  It is operational and opened to trained users.
Location
Bagley 83
Specifications
Baseline Flatness (–50 to 300°C)
≤10 µW
Baseline Repeatability (–50 to 300°C)
<20 µW
Temperature Range (as installed)
–90 to 725°C with RCS 90 cooler
Temperature Accuracy
±0.05°C
Temperature Precision
±0.008°C
Enthalpy Precision
±0.08%
